+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Option
+
+
+class OptionHiddenKey(Option):
+    """An :class:`~click.core.Option` whose :meth:`to_info_dict` reports
+    the hidden state under the ``is_hidden`` key instead of ``hidden``.
+    """
+
+    def to_info_dict(self) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+        info_dict = super(Option, self).to_info_dict()
+        info_dict.update(
+            help=self.help,
+            prompt=self.prompt,
+            is_flag=self.is_flag,
+            flag_value=self.flag_value,
+            count=self.count,
+            is_hidden=self.hidden,
+        )
+        return info_dict

+import click
+from click.option_hidden_key import OptionHiddenKey
+
+
+def test_to_info_dict_uses_is_hidden_key():
+    opt = OptionHiddenKey(["--name"], hidden=True)
+    expected = click.Option(["--name"], hidden=True).to_info_dict()
+    expected["is_hidden"] = expected.pop("hidden")
+    info = opt.to_info_dict()
+    assert info == expected
+    assert list(info) == list(expected)
+    assert "hidden" not in info
+    assert info["is_hidden"] is True
+
+
+def test_works_as_command_param():
+    @click.command(cls=click.Command)
+    @click.option("--flag", cls=OptionHiddenKey, is_flag=True)
+    def cli(flag):
+        pass
+
+    ctx = click.Context(cli)
+    info = ctx.to_info_dict()["command"]["params"][0]
+    assert info["is_hidden"] is False
+    assert "hidden" not in info
